reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, category_id, launch_date,
  LAG(launch_date) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY launch_date, product_id) AS prev_launch_date
FROM products
WHERE category_id IN (15, 16, 17)
  AND launch_date IS NOT NULL
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.launch_date,
  (SELECT MAX(p2.launch_date) FROM products p2
   WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id
     AND (p2.launch_date < p.launch_date OR (p2.launch_date = p.launch_date AND p2.product_id < p.product_id))) AS prev_launch_date
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id IN (15, 16, 17)
  AND p.launch_date IS NOT NULL

WITH launched AS (
  -- one row per product with a known launch date in the three categories
  SELECT product_id, category_id, launch_date
  FROM products
  WHERE category_id IN (15, 16, 17)
    AND launch_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT product_id, category_id, launch_date,
  LAG(launch_date) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY launch_date, product_id) AS prev_launch_date
FROM launched

other_way.tradeoff: A subquery that takes the latest earlier launch in the category also works, but its tie rule is longer to write than LAG's.
